answer:
October whispers coat the maples,  
Red and gold in hanging hemps,  
A rustling blanket quilt, stolen up,  
Offered to the cleanup of the roar,  
As winter sleeps in slow, pale fear,  
The leaves themselves are nothing; only  
The sound of them, a thousand drums,  
Rippling down with daily rites.
